name: deere.customer-voice
description: Public construction equipment thread classification; advisory, no prevalence or causal verdict.

theme.instructions: Select the primary operational issue in the supplied public thread; use unclear when no issue predominates. Do not infer missing facts.

criteria.dealer_service: Dealer responsiveness, parts delivery, service diagnosis or uptime
criteria.repair_diagnostics: Access to diagnostic tools, manuals or independent repair
criteria.emissions: DEF, emissions-system faults or related maintenance
criteria.productivity: Grade, payload, machine control, ergonomics or job productivity
criteria.purchase_economics: Price, finance, used machine or ownership cost decisions
criteria.rental_capacity: Rental availability, temporary fleet capacity or rental economics
criteria.attachments: Attachments, machine fit and specific applications
criteria.switching: Switching brands or comparing experience without one operational cause
criteria.counterexample: Positive experience or contradictory observations without a primary complaint
criteria.unclear: Insufficient text or no clear relevant construction equipment issue

construction_relevance.instructions: The supplied body contains a concrete construction-equipment, heavy-equipment or compact-equipment use/purchase/service discussion; agricultural-only discussion does not qualify.

summary_fit.instructions: The paraphrase and limitations accurately represent the supplied excerpts, preserving uncertainty and contrary evidence; anecdotes are not verified brand performance.

complaint_present.instructions: At least one supplied excerpt expresses a concrete dissatisfaction or operational friction. Neutral requests and positive observations alone do not qualify.

rules.reason: Uncertain primary theme; retain for manual review.

notes.use: Retain positive/counterexample rows and uncertain rows with labels. No frequency, failure rate, market demand or execution authorization is inferred.
